Trump greets him, and they shake hands. They stand together talking and smiling for a moment as an off-screen reporter asks questions. The two men are dressed in suits.

spoken_summary: The Prime Minister of Australia greets President Trump. An off-screen reporter asks for Trump's message to the people of Australia, to which Trump replies, 'We love them.' When asked what they hope to accomplish, Trump says, 'A lot. A lot. Great things.' The Prime Minister adds, 'We're going to get a lot done.'
